column27: Harry Humphreys {{efn|name=talasea|Talasea Open MP [[Harry Humphreys]] died in 1988. [[Patterson Lowa]] won the resulting by-election later that year.}}
column39: Billy Kepi {{efn|name=okapa|Okapa Open MP [[Billy Kepi]] died in 1988. [[Castan Maibawa]] won the resulting by-election later that year.}}
column56: Marabe Makiba {{efn|name=komo|The National Court declared the election of Komo-Magarima MP [[Maribe Makiba]] to be void on 5 June 1989. [[Alfred Kaiabe]], the successful petitioner against Makiba, won the resulting by-election in 1990.}}
column58: Pius Malip {{efn|name=ambunti|Ambunti-Dreikikir Open MP [[Pius Malip]] died in a car accident on 21 November 1988. [[Judah Akesim]] won the resulting by-election in April 1989.}}
